timer_seconds 72000 (D57): the PICKUP's gate, not Brighteyes's: quest row TuskSlavePickUp (id 5066) min_Delta 72000 s = 20 h, max_Solves -1; ACE refuses to pick this tusk from a corpse that is not the player's own while the quest cannot be solved again (Player_Inventory.cs:1249-1262; HandleSolveError QuestManager.cs:558-578), so one Tusker Slave Tusk per 20 hours; a completion is recorded at the turn-in, so the next due time is never early

hunt-until: the carrier 22605 Tusker Slave is on the tusker-quarters profile's targets; the item is the tusk 22432 (one per kill, a guaranteed Contain row); the step's count 1 is checked before the hunt, so a tusk already held skips it (the autopilot's errand runs this same file)

The Aphus Lassel Portal Gem 22729 that Brighteyes gives is the rung change's fallback (item 4's travel file gems, 'aphus-lassel': spell 2936 'Entrance to Tusker Island', arriving at the Refuge 0xF6820033): the turn-in's reward is also the way back to the Refuge, and item 4's travel file names this item as its source
